title: Please improve AI quality
body:
The AI often not recognizing tasks, having time or command recognition errors. I tried prompting “please move all tasks from [date A] to [date B]” only to receive “there are no tasks planned on [date A]”. Also when prompting “please move tasks to 1:30pm”, the AI somehow moved the task to 10:30am instead. It also does not recognize command to order tasks in alphabetical order.

Scheduling app is nice to use otherwise.
author: Joshua Pasila

title: The AI is decent but not great, undone agenda items disappear
body: I think this app has great promise. I, personally, love the interface. But the AI’s ability to handle complicated asks like multiple tasks or memory related aspect that require context is disappointing considering what we get with modern AI. There’s also an issue about trying to keep undone daily agenda items. It takes a fair bit of effort to find them and reschedule them. There should be an easier option to find them. Promise but not meeting them despite relatively easy to hit

title: Fantastic app but not yet perfect

author: Limliyi

title: Great concept
body:
Great features:
- This app allows me to set the task of the day without the time so I can start the task, pause and resume throughout the day.
- I'm able to see the check list at the "Right Now" page and tick off the boxes. It helps me focus on what I need to do. 
- The activities and routines feature are a huge plus point. Saved me lots of efforts when planning the day ahead. 

Please add on:
PLEASE LET ME EDIT CHECKLIST FROM THE "RIGHT NOW" PAGE.

What needs to be improved:
- when I selected custom repetition for a task, I was expecting to be asked "For how long" so it would be a great feature to add on. 
- error prompt when deleting recently used activities. U can't deleted it so why have that feature? Either remove it or make it work 
- if I select areas outside of the box after making amendments to the task, there's a prompt asking if I want to save changes. When I click Save, it doesn't save for me but goes back to the original task and I have to edit all over. Would be great if we could just save the new edits

Nonetheless, I still enjoy this app! Thank you developers.
